import json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
folder=Path("docs/phase0-evidence/2026-10-26-integration")
decoder=json.JSONDecoder()
before=decoder.raw_decode((folder/"main-before-fixed.txt").read_text())[0]
after=decoder.raw_decode((folder/"main-after.txt").read_text())[0]
assert before == after, "Development configuration, containers or mounts changed"
print("PASSED: development Compose hash, container IDs/start times/health and persistent mounts unchanged.")
projects=set()
for name in ("reproduce-internal-network.txt","reproduce-internal-network-buildx-local.txt","integration.txt"):
    projects.update(re.findall(r"phase0-test-[0-9a-f]{32}",(folder/name).read_text()))
assert len(projects)==3
for project in sorted(projects):
    for args in (["ps","-a","-q"],["network","ls","-q"],["volume","ls","-q"]):
        cmd=["docker",*args,"--filter",f"label=com.docker.compose.project={project}"]
        result=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
        assert not result.stdout.strip(), (project,args,result.stdout)
    print(f"PASSED: {project}: no containers, networks or volumes remain.")
